basics.name: Mohsin Khan
basics.label: PhD Cybersecurity | Aspiring Security Professional (Blue & Red Team)
basics.summary: PhD in cybersecurity with strong systems-level expertise in IoT/OT security, distributed trust, and applied cryptography. My background combines academic rigor—evaluating 130+ cryptographic primitives and designing secure distributed architectures, with hands-on industry skills in vulnerability management, detection fundamentals, cloud security, and governance. I am actively transitioning into blue-team, red-team, or security engineering roles.

work.name: UiT – The Arctic University of Norway
work.summary: Conducted applied cybersecurity research on securing distributed IoT and OT systems under adversarial and resource-constrained conditions.
highlights: Designed secure distributed IoT and cloud architectures using Zero Trust principles, IAM-based access control, and STRIDE threat modeling, reducing attack surface and strengthening trust enforcement across multi-node systems.
Performed risk and impact analysis on distributed components to identify trust boundaries and failure modes, improving resilience against partial compromise, misconfiguration, and insider threats.

Developed a taxonomy and benchmarking framework for ~130 lightweight cryptographic primitives, evaluating performance, memory, energy, and cryptanalytic properties to support secure algorithm selection on constrained devices.

work.name: Blackbuck Insight
work.summary: Worked on large-scale data pipelines with a focus on secure cloud migration, access control, and operational reliability.
highlights: Migrated on-premise data pipelines to AWS using IAM-based access controls and monitoring, improving security posture and reducing data access risk.
Built and optimized distributed data processing workflows using PySpark, MapReduce, and Linux, enabling scalable and reliable analytics on high-volume datasets.
Improved pipeline observability and access separation, supporting secure production analytics and downstream decision-making.

projects.name: Distributed Trust Enforcement Architecture (DTEA)
projects.summary: Designed and implemented a blockchain-assisted capability-based access control framework for distributed IoT systems.
highlights: Smart-contract–based authorization with dynamic issuance, revocation, and auditability.
Validator-based trust coordination using PoA/QBFT consensus.
Evaluated latency, CPU, memory, and security guarantees under STRIDE.

projects.name: Lightweight Cryptography Benchmarking on Embedded Systems
projects.summary: Evaluated 130+ lightweight cryptographic primitives for performance, memory, and energy trade-offs on constrained devices.
highlights: Used ChipWhisperer with AVR ATxmega128 and ARM platforms.
Produced practitioner-oriented taxonomy for secure algorithm selection.
Direct relevance to IoT/OT security and post-quantum readiness.

projects.name: Healthcare Data Security & HIPAA Risk Assessment (Capstone)
projects.summary: Evaluated data security posture of a healthcare provider against HIPAA requirements.
highlights: Identified internal and external risks to patient data.
Recommended encryption, backup, and compliance-aligned controls.
Performed governance, risk, and compliance analysis.

projects.name: Cloud Security & Threat Mitigation for Manufacturing Systems
projects.summary: Designed secure cloud migration strategy and threat mitigation plan for an industrial organization.
highlights: Selected appropriate cloud models and security frameworks.
Applied threat modeling and vulnerability prioritization.
Focused on availability, safety, and OT constraints.
